svg.title: Evolution of the oldest-ready memory operation selector
svg.desc: Three generations of the selector that picks the oldest issuable operation among the eight Memory Queue entries. Generation 0 scans the entries serially, each comparison waiting on the previous best candidate. Generation 1 uses a balanced three-level tree of four, two and one comparison. Generation 2 compares every candidate against the other seven in parallel; a candidate is selected if it is issuable and no other issuable candidate is older, producing an eight-bit one-hot mask. The arithmetic Reservation Station is not part of this selector and still uses lowest-index-ready priority.
svg.text: best candidate so far flows right
each compare waits for the previous best candidate
delay grows with every extra entry
Every candidate vs. the other seven
one-hot mask: exactly one bit set
